_comment: Claude Desktop 3P managed configuration - Amazon Bedrock.
Unlike Windows and macOS, this file uses NATIVE JSON types - real booleans,
real arrays, real numbers. Do not quote them.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the app and are safe to leave in place.
_auth: Pick ONE of the blocks below and delete the rest.
_auth_profile: Named AWS profile - reuses credentials already on the box.
_auth_sso: AWS SSO - SsoRegion is the IAM Identity Center HOME region.
_auth_token: Static bearer token - simplest, does not rotate, shared identity.
_auth_helper: Credential helper - an executable that prints credentials.
_models: Discover what the account can invoke, or pin a list. First entry is the default. The regional prefix (us./eu./apac.) must match the region above.
_offline: Linux has no offline installer, so the app still needs downloads.claude.ai at session start. Turning off auto-updates avoids a failing startup call.
_egress: Hosts the agent's own web-fetch and shell tools may reach. Separate from and stricter than your perimeter firewall.
_workspace: Folders the agent may work in.
